MetaDescription.value: University of Chicago students and faculty are surrounded by unique architecture, Lake Michigan, museums, and a variety of arts and cultural opportunities.

value.alt: Group of students laying in leaves

description.value: Our community is completely intertwined with the city we call home. At our Hyde Park campus, located in one of Chicago’s most eclectic neighborhoods, you will be surrounded by storied architecture, majestic parks, Lake Michigan, world-class museums, and a plethora of arts and cultural opportunities both locally and in the wider city of Chicago.
Our main campus is in Chicago’s Hyde Park neighborhood—a historic area just south of downtown Chicago, known for its diversity and strong sense of community.

value.alt: University of Chicago Hyde Park campus view from a drone.

title.value: Life in Chicago and Hyde Park

ARIALabelText.value: Learn more about life in Hyde park

description.value: Different backgrounds and perspectives make us better scholars and leaders. We’re deeply committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse learning environment, and we invite all members of our community to participate in this vital and ongoing work with dedicated programming, tools, and resources.

value.title: Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion

description.value:
<br class="t-last-br" />
As a student at UChicago, you join some of the brightest minds in the world. You’ll be challenged in ways you would never expect and form lifelong connections at this intellectual destination.<br class="t-last-br" />

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about  our arts institutions and programs

description.value: Artistic and cultural experiences enrich your life and spark your creativity. Opportunities to get involved are everywhere.
Eighteen intercollegiate sports involve more than 500 students each year in 300 contests, and a wide range of intramural and recreational activities are open to the University community.

value.alt: University of Chicago football players during a match.

description.value: The best way to experience life at UChicago is to see it for yourself. Here you’ll find information for resources available to you on campus.

ctaARIALabelText.value: Learn more about health and wellness

description.value: Your well-being is our top priority. There are many options for medical and mental health services, along with wellness programs and resources.
